tagline: Making Possible products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve
hero_kpi_rationale: Zero organic growth in 2025 despite higher volumes, offset by raw material deflation and pricing pressure

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The portion of revenue that remains after paying production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin is not quantified directly, but the effects of raw material deflation on pricing are mentioned as a key factor.
kpis.signal: Stable margin despite pricing pressure from raw material deflation.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated before taxes relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is not provided, but the decline in net income is explained by higher costs despite productivity gains.
kpis.signal: Operating margin impacted by higher labor and interest expenses.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount the company invests in innovation and development of new products.
kpis.description: No data on research and development expenses in the provided documents.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on new plants, machinery, or equipment.
kpis.description: Documents do not mention capital expenditures.

kpis.name: Workforce Reduction
kpis.explanation: Number of positions eliminated as part of the 2025 restructuring plan.
kpis.description: In 2025, the company reduced approximately 1,200 positions under its restructuring plan, recording $48.8M in restructuring charges.
kpis.signal: Reduction of 1,200 positions as part of a cost optimization initiative.

kpis.name: Adjusted Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash available after operating and investing expenses, adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: The term is defined in the MD&A as operating cash flow minus capex and software expenditures, plus or minus certain gains and losses. No value is provided in the documents.
kpis.signal: No figure available, but the concept is used to assess financial flexibility.

kpis.name: Organic Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Change in revenue excluding foreign exchange and acquisition effects.
kpis.description: In 2025, organic growth was zero: volume increases were offset by price declines due to raw material deflation.
kpis.signal: Zero organic growth in 2025, despite volume gains offset by price declines.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all costs and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income decreased from $705M in 2024 to $688M in 2025, due to higher labor, interest, and investment costs, partially offset by productivity gains.
kpis.signal: Decline in net income in 2025 despite productivity gains.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in over 50 countries and 69% of revenue comes from international operations. Geopolitical tensions between the U.S., China, India, and the European Union, as well as changes in economic conditions and trade regulations, could have a significant negative impact.

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces competition in the markets it serves, and shifts in customer preferences or technologies could reduce demand for its products.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in environmental and sustainability regulations could negatively impact the company if it does not respond appropriately.

risks.title: Currency Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in exchange rates, which could negatively affect its sales and revenue. With 69% of sales from international sources, exposure is significant.

risks.title: Raw Material Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in raw material prices, which could negatively impact its costs and revenue. In 2025, raw material deflation led to price reductions that offset volume gains.

risks.title: Climate and Environmental Risk
risks.score_rationale: Climate change and stricter environmental regulations could increase operating costs and create additional compliance obligations.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates over 200 manufacturing and distribution facilities across more than 50 countries, making it vulnerable to supply chain disruptions.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning in AVY's 10-K report.
